subject: Opening an exec window to unblock pilot — proposed VP/CTO intro
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Opening an exec window to unblock pilot — proposed VP/CTO intro

Hi Sara — great chat earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Summary from call:
- Brightlane goal: 50% reduction in inference cost on customer-facing search while improving latency under 150ms p95.
- Key constraints: PCI-adjacent data flows (no customer PII to third-party logs), strict runtime SLOs, and a pilot runway of ~8 weeks.
- Evaluation metrics: latency p95, tokens-per-dollar, and inference correctness on top 200 search prompts.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Exec handshake (VP/CTO) — 30 min: align on security/commercial guardrails and confirm pilot sponsorship.
2) Technical deep dive (60 min): infra architect + model choices — follow exec call.
3) Share a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a baseline post-call deck (attached).

Proposed exec windows (PT):
- Tue Oct 12, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Oct 13, 14:30–15:00
- Thu Oct 14, 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, send over two slots that fit the VP/CTO calendar and we’ll lock it. We’ll plan the technical deep dive for the following week and bring Marissa for infra detail.

Attachment: post-call-deck.pdf (brief deck + initial MAP draft)

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Neha — great summary and appreciated the clear MAP. Tom (our CTO) is looped in. He asked me to confirm a few items before we lock a slot: 
- Quick note on data flow: can your hosted offering be configured to not persist request logs for our pilot? (we can discuss specifics on the call)
- High level pricing expectation for a small pilot (est. 200k tokens/day) — ballpark is fine for the exec sync.

Tom and I are both available for a short exec alignment next week; our preference would be a morning slot PT. From your list, Thu Oct 14 09:00 PT looks promising. If that works on your end, we can lock and then add the 60-min technical deep dive on Tue Oct 19.

Attaching a short doc with our internal priorities: Brightlane-requirements.pdf
